title: Microsoft says Microsoft 365 availability is improving as the outage stretches into a second day, disrupting governments, hospitals, and businesses globally (Bruce Gil/Gizmodo)
summary: Bruce Gil / Gizmodo: Microsoft says Microsoft 365 availability is improving as the outage stretches into a second day, disrupting governments, hospitals, and businesses globally — The tech giant is racing to fully restore Outlook, Teams, and other Microsoft 365 services following a widespread outage.
